ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_PROC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE COMMIT_PROC IS
 test_id varchar2(10);
 cur_rec number(4) := :system.cursor_record;
 rg_id RecordGroup;
 gc_id1 GroupColumn;
 gc_id2 GroupColumn;
 found Boolean; 
 msg varchar2(2000); -- V04
BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('S_HOLDING_TESTS');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 rg_id := FIND_GROUP('RES_CNT');
 IF not ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 delete_group(rg_id);
 END IF;
 rg_id := CREATE_GROUP('RES_CNT');
 gc_id1 := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id,'RES',CHAR_COLUMN,10);
 gc_id2 := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id,'CNT',NUMBER_COLUMN);
 loop 
 IF :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2 is not null THEN
 found := FALSE; 
 for i in 1.. GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id)
 loop 
 IF GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1,i) = :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2 THEN
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,i, GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,i) + 1);
 found := TRUE;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 IF not found THEN
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1,GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id),:s_holding_tests.temp_result_2);
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id),1);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 NEXT_RECORD;
 end loop;
 go_record(cur_rec);
 msg := 'Results Entered - ';
 for i in 1..GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id)
 loop
 msg := msg || to_char(GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,i)) || ':';
 msg := msg || GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1,i) || '; ';
 end loop;
 show_error('9200',msg);
 savepoint A;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 loop
 IF nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.full_tech_2,'N') = 'N' 
 and :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2 is null
 THEN
 IF rep_needed THEN
 :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2 := 'NULL';
 ELSE
 :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2 := :s_holding_tests.temp_result_1;
 END IF;
 :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2_user_id := :banner.user_id;
 :s_holding_tests.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 :s_holding_tests.result_dats := sysdate;
 ELSIF :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2 is not null THEN 
 :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2_user_id := :banner.user_id;
 :s_holding_tests.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 :s_holding_tests.result_dats := sysdate;
 END IF;
 INSERT_TEST_BAND;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 post;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 loop
 IF :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2 is not null THEN
 IF :s_holding_tests.temp_result_1 != :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2 THEN
 show_error('9301');
 exit;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 MOVE_RESULTS;
 post;
 update_reconcile;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: MOVE_RESULTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE MOVE_RESULTS IS
 tresult varchar2(80);
 temp_x varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM holding_tests
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 AND tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND (result_status_1 is null
 OR result_status_2 is not null);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 /* Commented by Sobha per the new requirements in the Testing Module */
 /* tresult := sbclib.move_holding_tests(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.test_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id,
 null,
 :banner.prog_name); */
 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'x' 
 INTO :GLOBAL.x 
 FROM test_batch_parms
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 AND test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 DECLARE
 tresult varchar2(80);
 BEGIN
 tresult := sbclib.move_holding_tests(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.test_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id,
 null,
 :banner.prog_name);
 IF nvl(tresult,'null') != '0' THEN
 show_error('3106',tresult);
 END IF;
 END;
 END; 
 
 WHEN others THEN
 message('Error in moving tests');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: REP_NEEDED
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION REP_NEEDED RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 rep_needed varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 SELECT nvl(second_tech,'N') INTO rep_needed 
 FROM valid_test_results
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 AND result_status = :s_holding_tests.temp_result_1
 AND ((plate_seq = 'I' and :s_antigen_flag = 'Y') or
 plate_seq = 'R')
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 AND rownum = 1;
 IF rep_needed = 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 ELSE 
 return FALSE;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_RECONCILE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_reconcile IS
BEGIN
 go_block('s_holding_tests');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2 is not null then
 update test_batch_det
 set reconcile_date = sysdate,
 reconcile_flag = 'Y'
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id and
 test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id and
 0 = (select count(*)
 from holding_tests
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id and
 test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id and
 (temp_result_1 is null or
 temp_result_2 is null or
 result_status_2 is not null));
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop; 
commit;
IF not FORM_SUCCESS THEN
 rollback to A;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('0230');
 ELSE
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('0000') ;
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM'); 
 END IF;
/*Commented by Sobha 09/21/01 
 holding_status is null);*/
/*
(temp_result_1 is null or
 temp_result_2 is null or
 result_status_2 is not null)
*/
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error updating reconcile_flag for test_batch_det');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
